# Bobine Unified Linux Package Repositories (packages.bobine.fit)

> Official cryptographically signed Linux package repositories (APT, DNF/RPM, and Pacman) for Bobine (https://bobine.fit) — the free, open-source (AGPL-3.0) offline-first video and audio playout system for sports clubs, fitness studios, and digital signage.

## Overview
- **Unified Repository Host**: https://packages.bobine.fit
- **Legacy APT Mirror (Compatible)**: https://apt.bobine.fit
- **Supported Architectures**:
  - `x86_64` / `amd64`: Intel Core Ultra (Series 1 & 2), Intel Core i3/i5/i7/i9, Intel Processor N100 / N200 / N95 / N305, Intel Celeron J4105 / J4125 (Dell Wyse 5070), AMD Ryzen 5000 / 7000 / 8000 / 9000 Series (Zen 3, Zen 4, Zen 5).
  - `aarch64` / `arm64`: Qualcomm Snapdragon X Elite & X Plus, Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 / 8 Gen 3 / 8 Elite, Apple Silicon M1 / M2 / M3 / M4 (Asahi Linux & VM), NVIDIA DGX Spark (Grace Blackwell) & Jetson Orin, Raspberry Pi 5 (Broadcom BCM2712), Rockchip RK3588 (Orange Pi 5, Radxa Rock 5B), MediaTek Dimensity / Kompanio, Google Tensor G2 / G3 / G4.
- **Supported Distribution Families**:
  - **Debian & Ubuntu (APT — `.deb`)**: Debian 12 (Bookworm), Debian 13 (Trixie), Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (Jammy), Ubuntu 24.04 LTS (Noble), Linux Mint 21/22, Pop!_OS, Zorin OS, Raspberry Pi OS.
  - **Fedora & Enterprise Linux (DNF — `.rpm`)**: Fedora Workstation 39/40/41+, Nobara Linux, Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL 9), AlmaLinux 9, Rocky Linux 9, openSUSE Tumbleweed/Leap.
  - **Arch Linux & Derivatives (Pacman — `.pkg.tar.zst`)**: Arch Linux, EndeavourOS, CachyOS, Manjaro Linux, Arch Linux ARM.
- **Cryptographic Signature**: OpenPGP RSA 4096-bit signing key
- **Key Fingerprint**: `B77D 96D7 2F84 F36A CAA3 F872 9CBF 497D 829E E15A`
- **Key Identity**: `Bobine APT Repository <contact@bobine.fit>`
- **Public Key Location**: https://packages.bobine.fit/bobine.gpg
- **Release Channels**: `stable` (production releases), `beta` (curated pre-releases), `canary` (continuous rolling builds from `main`).

## 1. Debian & Ubuntu (APT)

### Import Official GPG Keyring
```bash
sudo install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings
curl -fsSL https://packages.bobine.fit/bobine.gpg | sudo gpg --dearmor --yes -o /etc/apt/keyrings/bobine.gpg
```

### Add Repository & Install
```bash
echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/bobine.gpg] https://packages.bobine.fit/debian stable main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/bobine.list
sudo apt update && sudo apt install bobine
```
*(Replace `stable` with `beta` or `canary` to follow pre-release channels.)*

## 2. Fedora, RHEL, AlmaLinux & Rocky Linux (DNF / RPM)

### Fedora 41+ (DNF 5)
```bash
sudo dnf config-manager addrepo --from-repofile=https://packages.bobine.fit/fedora/bobine-stable.repo
sudo dnf install bobine
```

### Fedora 39/40, RHEL, AlmaLinux, Rocky Linux (DNF 4)
```bash
sudo dnf config-manager --add-repo https://packages.bobine.fit/fedora/bobine-stable.repo
sudo dnf install bobine
```
*(Available repo files: `bobine-stable.repo`, `bobine-beta.repo`, `bobine-canary.repo`.)*

## 3. Arch Linux, EndeavourOS, CachyOS & Manjaro (Pacman)

### Import & Locally Sign Key
```bash
curl -fsSL https://packages.bobine.fit/bobine.gpg | sudo pacman-key --add -
sudo pacman-key --lsign-key B77D96D72F84F36ACAA3F8729CBF497D829EE15A
```

### Configure `/etc/pacman.conf` & Install
```ini
[bobine]
SigLevel = Required DatabaseOptional
Server = https://packages.bobine.fit/arch/stable/$arch
```
```bash
sudo pacman -Sy bobine
```
